facts.title: Ankle-break flow gain
facts.text: +5% flow gain when ankle breaking someone. Dribbler shot power boost was also reduced by 10% in this patch.

facts.title: Shot power multiplier
facts.text: Shot power increased from 1.175 to 1.25 at that date.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Ball physics and style balance
history.text: Ball physics made independent of FPS; King, Isagi, Yukimiya and flow balances announced.

history.title: King and flow rework
history.text: King and its associated flow reworked.
